    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.

    remaining = bins - item
    exact = remaining == 0
    underfill = remaining > 0
    overfill = remaining < 0

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """

    ideal = 0.7
    width_before = 0.2
    width_after = 0.4

    mask_low = future_utilization <= ideal
    scores[mask_low] = np.where(future_utilization[mask_low] >= ideal - width_before,
                                 (future_utilization[mask_low] - (ideal - width_before)) / width_before,
                                 0)
    scores[~mask_low] = np.where(future_utilization[~mask_low] <= ideal + width_after,
                                  1 - (future_utilization[~mask_low] - ideal) / width_after,
                                  0)
    return scores
